title: He built an app with AI and sold it for $80M

beats.say: Nobody makes real money with AI apps.

panel.text: Nobody makes money with AI apps

beats.say: Maor Shlomo built Base44 mostly alone, with no outside funding. About six months later, Wix paid eighty million dollars in cash.

panel.label: Wix paid, all cash
panel.sub: Base44 · June 2025 · built mostly solo, no funding

beats.say: Around two hundred fifty thousand users. And one hundred eighty nine thousand dollars of net profit in May alone.
It started as a side project. He kept posting his progress on LinkedIn and Twitter, and people showed up.
So I just post every day?
Pick one painful problem. Build the first version with Claude. Show your work. Get your first paying user.
Most won't reach eighty million. But shipping in public is how you get a shot.

caption: Base44's founder Maor Shlomo built the vibe-coding app mostly solo with no outside funding, and about six months in Wix bought it for $80M cash (June 2025). At the sale: roughly 250K users and $189K net profit in May. It began as a side project, and he posted progress on LinkedIn and Twitter. Most people won't get an exit like that, but the playbook is real: pick one painful problem, build v1 with Claude, post daily, get a paying user. Building your own app? Use code AT100 on Base44 (link in bio).
pinned_comment: The prompt: Help me find one painful problem I can solve with a small app. Interview me about my skills and the people I know, give me 5 niche ideas, rank them by how easily I could get a first paying customer, and write a one-week build plan for the best one.
